title: Propose a registered per-object serverFail SetError to the JMAP WG
description: DECISIONS.md 38 (Mark 2026-11-19): handlers report unexpected per-object storage failures as SetError type serverFail, which RFC 8620 §5.3 does not define (it is a method-level error there). Keep current behaviour; draft a short proposal for the JMAP WG (mailing list or an errata/registry request for the JMAP SetError types registry) for Mark to send. Revisit code after the discussion.
